== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Ominous Rumors (V)]] (Original text), as published: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif Holotable image repository, commit 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024. Uploaded unchanged (byte-for-byte copy of that commit's file; the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name, so it is uploaded here with a .png extension). Later replaced at the same address by the next version's image.
